then.description: Add the verbs **detonate** and **magnify** to the Evocation School's repertoire, and when you **Make Camp** you can always mark Evocation in addition to your normal 3 Prepared Schools.

else.description:
Gain the **Weave the Arcane** Wizard Starting Move, though you only have access to Evocation. You start with Evocation Prepared; mark it now.

 You can **Cast a Spell**+int by combining a verb and a substance from Evocation to create an effect, as long as you have your arcane focus, both hands otherwise free, and the ability to speak aloud.

outcomes.text: Your unique 7-9 option is: forget Evocation until you next **Make Camp**

submoves.title: Mental Reserves
submoves.description: You can mark a **Condition** to instantly Prepare a School of Magic, up to your normal limit.

title: Contingency
description: Mark 1-3 Conditions then choose a spell or a Move that you have access to that you could reasonably prepare in advance. Also, define a specific circumstance. When the **circumstance occurs**, roll+Conditions marked; use the result to resolve the spell or Move.

title: Elemental Cloak
description: Mark 1-3 **Conditions** to evoke a cloak made of one of the following elements. Replace X with the amount of Conditions marked:

bullets: Cascading flames — Up to X opponents who inflict dmg to you suffer Xd6 dmg
Rock protrusions — Add +X to your armor for X attacks
Icy garments — Up to X opponents who inflict dmg to you have **dis** to their dmg rolls
Wild gale — You can mobilize unimpeded up to **near** X times

title: Instant Fireball!
description: Mark 1-3 Conditions, then a **near** target and everyone **close** to them suffers Xd6 dmg **piercing**, where X is the amount of Conditions marked.

title: Power Weapon
description: When you **shape an elemental energy in the form of a weapon**, mark spend 1-3 Conditions then roll+Conditions marked.

outcomes.text: Choose two of the following tags.
The element breaks free; mark 1 XP and the GM makes a Move.

submoves.description: By default the weapon inflicts 1d6 dmg, is **hand**, and has 3 uses. When you **Trade Blows** with this weapon, roll+int (instead of +str or +dex) and mark one use.
